mapper.select: WITH base AS (SELECT s.student_id, p.payment_key, s.student_name, SUM(pd.amount) AS billPrice, cc.class_name, cc.class_type FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_payment p ON s.student_id = p.student_id JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key AND ta.time_table_key = pd.time_table_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (t.user_code = #{userCode} OR #{userCode} = 'all') AND pd.item_type = #{itemType} GROUP BY s.student_id, p.payment_key, s.student_name, cc.class_name, cc.class_type), allClassInfo AS (SELECT ta.student_id, STUFF((SELECT ',' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON ta2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t2.class_key = cc2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = ta.student_id AND t2.yy = #{year} AND t2.mm = #{month} AND t2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND cc2.class_type IN ('1', '2') ORDER BY cc2.class_type, cc2.class_name FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') AS all_subjects FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY ta.student_id), standardFees AS (SELECT ta.student_id, SUM(COALESCE(cfm.fee, 0)) AS standard_edu_fee FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map_copy cfm ON t.class_key = cfm.class_key AND t.center_code = cfm.center_code AND cfm.category = CASE WHEN s.is_hoho = 1 THEN 'hoho' WHEN s.is_hoho = 0 AND cc.class_type = '1' THEN 'han' WHEN s.is_hoho = 0 AND cc.class_type = '2' THEN 'book' END WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (t.user_code = #{userCode} OR #{userCode} = 'all') AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY ta.student_id) SELECT b.student_id AS studentId, b.payment_key AS paymentKey, pb.bill_id AS billId, b.student_name AS studentName, SUM(b.billPrice) AS billPrice, CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN aci.all_subjects ELSE STUFF((SELECT ',' + b2.class_name FROM base b2 WHERE b2.student_id = b.student_id AND b2.payment_key = b.payment_key ORDER BY b2.class_type FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 1, '') END AS subject, CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE oc.other_teachers END AS otherTeacher, CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE oc.other_class_names END AS otherSubject, CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE oc.other_subject_type END AS otherSubjectType, COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(pb_pay.bill_amount, 0) AS paidAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(b.billPrice) - (COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(pb_pay.bill_amount, 0)) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(b.billPrice) - (COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(pb_pay.bill_amount, 0)) END AS unpaidAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(b.billPrice) = 0 THEN '할인' WHEN COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(pb_pay.bill_amount, 0) = 0 THEN '미결제' WHEN COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE(pb_pay.bill_amount, 0) >= SUM(b.billPrice) THEN '결제완료' ELSE '부분결제' END AS payStatus, CASE WHEN SUM(b.billPrice) = 0 THEN 'discount' WHEN p.status = 'pending' AND COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'nonIssue_off' WHEN p.status = 'pending' THEN 'nonIssue' WHEN pb.status = 'destroyed' AND COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'destroyed_off' WHEN pb.status = 'destroyed' THEN 'destroyed' WHEN pb.status = 'canceled' AND COALESCE(pm.manual_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 'canceled_off' WHEN pb.status = 'canceled' THEN 'canceled' ELSE 'issued' END AS issuanceStatus, pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone, NULLIF( STUFF((SELECT ', ' + s2.student_name FROM erp_student s2 LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa2 ON s2.student_id = pa2.student_id WHERE pa2.parent_tel_first = pa.parent_tel_first AND pa2.parent_tel_middle = pa.parent_tel_middle AND pa2.parent_tel_last = pa.parent_tel_last AND s2.student_id != b.student_id AND s2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND s2.status_key NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN') FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, ''), '' ) AS samePhoneStudents, CASE WHEN sf.standard_edu_fee IS NOT NULL AND sf.standard_edu_fee > 0 AND SUM(b.billPrice) != sf.standard_edu_fee THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isPriceModified, sf.standard_edu_fee AS standardFee FROM base b LEFT JOIN allClassInfo aci ON b.student_id = aci.student_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{userCode} != 'all' THEN STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ',' + u2.user_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON ta2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_user u2 ON t2.user_code = u2.user_code WHERE ta2.student_id = b.student_id AND t2.yy = #{year} AND t2.mm = #{month} AND t2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t2.user_code <> #{userCode} FOR XML PATH ('') , TYPE).value('.' , 'nvarchar(max)') , 1 , 1 , '') END AS other_teachers , CASE WHEN #{userCode} != 'all' THEN STUFF((SELECT ',' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta3 JOIN erp_time_table t3 ON ta3.time_table_key = t3.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t3.class_key = cc2.class_key WHERE ta3.student_id = b.student_id AND t3.yy = #{year} AND t3.mm = #{month} AND t3.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t3.user_code <> #{userCode} ORDER BY cc2.class_type FOR XML PATH ('') , TYPE).value('.' , 'nvarchar(max)') , 1 , 1 , '') END AS other_class_names , CASE WHEN #{userCode} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX (CAST (s.is_hoho AS TINYINT)) = 1 THEN 'hoho' WHEN MAX (CASE WHEN cc2.class_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'han' WHEN MAX (CASE WHEN cc2.class_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'book' ELSE NULL END FROM erp_time_table_assign ta4 JOIN erp_time_table t4 ON ta4.time_table_key = t4.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t4.class_key = cc2.class_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta4.student_id = s.student_id WHERE ta4.student_id = b.student_id AND t4.yy = #{year} AND t4.mm = #{month} AND t4.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t4.user_code <> #{userCode} ) END AS other_subject_type ) oc JOIN erp_payment p ON b.payment_key = p.payment_key LEFT JOIN erp_parent pa ON b.student_id = pa.student_id LEFT JOIN standardFees sf ON b.student_id = sf.student_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_key, status, bill_id FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_key ORDER BY created_at DESC) rn FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE bill_type = #{itemType}) x WHERE rn = 1) pb ON b.payment_key = pb.payment_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_key, SUM (card_amount + cash_amount + transfer_amount) AS manual_amount FROM erp_payment_manual GROUP BY payment_key) pm ON b.payment_key = pm.payment_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_key, SUM (amount) AS bill_amount FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'approved' AND bill_type = #{itemType} GROUP BY payment_key) pb_pay ON b.payment_key = pb_pay.payment_key GROUP BY b.student_id, b.payment_key, b.student_name, pb.bill_id, pb.status, p.status, pm.manual_amount, pb_pay.bill_amount, oc.other_teachers, oc.other_class_names, oc.other_subject_type, pa.parent_tel_first, pa.parent_tel_middle, pa.parent_tel_last, sf.standard_edu_fee, aci.all_subjects ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM (b.billPrice) = 0 THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE (pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE (pb_pay.bill_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE (pm.manual_amount, 0) + COALESCE (pb_pay.bill_amount, 0) < SUM (b.billPrice) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END , CASE WHEN p.status = 'pending' THEN 1 WHEN pb.status = 'destroyed' THEN 2 WHEN pb.status = 'canceled' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , pa.parent_tel_first, pa.parent_tel_middle, pa.parent_tel_last, b.student_name
